description: Proposed 1st Avenue BRT changes included dedicated center bus lanes.
The plan would have removed 61 on-street parking stalls.
It aimed to improve transit reliability and downtown access.

chips.text: Defeated (5-6)
5 for, 6 against
Dedicated BRT lanes increased ridership 400% in another Canadian city.
Ready Properties, owning 11 downtown buildings, raised concerns about alley access.
Administration stated yield-to-bus policies have 'limited effect' without enforcement.
Unclear how BRT would move 15,000 people from a future arena.
Midtown Plaza fully supported dedicated bus lanes for downtown vibrancy.
Councillor Donauer raised concerns about potential loss of federal funding for a pilot.
Administration warned of federal funding payback risk if project scope changed.
Administration committed to report back on business access concerns before tendering.
